q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: WITH TEMP AS (SELECT C.NAME AS NAME_IN, O.COM_ID, O.SALES_ID AS SALES_IN FROM COMPANY C RIGHT JOIN ORDERS O ON C.COM_ID = O.COM_ID WHERE C.NAME = 'RED') SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE SALES_ID NOT IN (SELECT SALES_IN FROM TEMP)
